netfeez_aurora_lights.setting.other_play: Shows held-item glow for nearby players.
netfeez_aurora_lights.setting.dropped_it: Shows glow for replicated dropped glowing items. Works without a server-side mod.
netfeez_aurora_lights.setting.light_colo: Tints this mod's glow and, with the companion shader pack selected, colored block light.
netfeez_aurora_lights.setting.enchanted_: Adds a faint violet halo around enchanted items, armor and framed items.
netfeez_aurora_lights.setting.item_frame: Shows glow for luminous items displayed in item frames.
